policies.name: Declared and running dependencies are compatible
policies.description: Generic: re-run every compatibility check (driver and engine, runtime engine, package conflicts, deprecated APIs) against the live graph. Written for any system before any scored SREGym attempt; encodes no knowledge of SREGym faults.

policies.name: No service has an outsized blast radius
policies.description: Generic: warn when a service has more than 10 transitively affected dependents within 4 hops.
